primary_goal.definition: Average daily visits to https://gnsresearchhub.vercel.app over a rolling 30-day period. Prefer unique visitors when provider data is available; otherwise use page sessions/visits consistently and label the limitation.

measurement_status.provider_checked: Live Vercel Web Analytics script and GA4 tag remain provider-ready, but central visit export is unavailable in this runtime. This run added evidence-focus-watchlist-v1: the dashboard now exposes sanitized next-loop WATCHLIST focus cards with UTM-tagged item-detail links and a public next_loop_focus JSON artifact, so BSS owners/reps can see exactly which weak items are being improved without treating search queries as evidence.
measurement_status.raw_result: measurement pending: GA4_PROPERTY_ID plus service-account reporting access or approved Vercel Analytics export/API is still required to calculate rolling 30-day visits and component-level growth events.
measurement_status.interpretation: Traffic progress still cannot be claimed. The new focus-watchlist component improves repeat-visit/share reasons and exposes feedback-loop direction while preserving evidence discipline.

north_star: Help BSS retail owners find practical, evidence-backed product insights often enough that the hub becomes a repeat visit destination.
growth_channels: A/B testing of landing and CTA copy

needs_user_permission_or_credentials.why: The GA4 tag is live, but this cron run cannot read GA4 reporting data without a GA4 property ID plus a service-account JSON/key mounted in env or another approved server-side access method. Needed to report rolling 30-day visits centrally.

VERCEL_TOKEN can deploy and read project metadata, but this runtime could not retrieve Web Analytics reporting; tested web-insights endpoints returned 404/not_found. Need an approved Vercel Analytics export/API method or dashboard export to measure rolling 30-day visits and custom growth events.
A memorable domain improves trust, repeat visits, and shareability versus a vercel.app URL.
Actual X/Twitter posting requires xurl CLI availability and OAuth credentials configured outside the agent session; never paste secrets into chat.
Paid tests require explicit budget, platform, and stop-loss rules before execution.

initial_experiments.success_metric: ranking CTA clicks and item card clicks per visit
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Retail-owner action language will produce more clicks than evidence-first language for busy BSS owners.

initial_experiments.success_metric: share intent clicks, copy-link events, and UTM-attributed return visits
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Owner-ready share links with item-specific display tips will increase repeat visits and make SNS/sales-rep distribution measurable once analytics is connected.

initial_experiments.success_metric: measured visits, ranking CTA clicks, item card clicks, and share/copy events by UTM channel
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Provider-backed measurement will distinguish real growth from routine refresh/deploy activity.

initial_experiments.success_metric: organic landing visits to ranking and item detail pages; indexed URL count; item-card clicks from organic sessions
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Canonical URLs, OG/Twitter images, schema.org ItemList/Product JSON-LD, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml make item-ranking pages easier to index and share, increasing repeatable organic visits toward 500/day.

initial_experiments.success_metric: item detail share/copy clicks and UTM-attributed return visits
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Specific item-detail pages with owner-ready display/risk copy create more repeat visits than timeframe-only sharing links.

initial_experiments.success_metric: UTM-attributed growth_exposure/growth_click/growth_share_copy_result events preserved across ranking and item-detail navigation
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Persisting first-touch and current-touch UTM values will make owner_share, X, email, and sales-rep links measurable even when visitors click internal item pages without query strings.

initial_experiments.success_metric: pre-deploy Playwright catches public data/SEO/growth marker regressions before Vercel production
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Serving e2e QA from the same public output directory and /data/* URLs used by Vercel will prevent silent live 404/tracking regressions and make growth instrumentation more trustworthy.

initial_experiments.success_metric: items_with_retail_product_url, items_with_tiktok_shop_url, product_image_items, and lower avoidable supply-coverage regressions without increasing unsupported trend claims
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Strict fallback aliases for item-level listing collectors will keep BSS-owner dashboard cards actionable when exact word order misses live product pages, while preserving watchlist/trend-evidence separation.

initial_experiments.success_metric: item card clicks, ranking scroll engagement, share/copy events, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners are more likely to use and share the ranking when each card shows the immediate display test, shrink/risk caution, and short owner-facing phrase before the detail-page click.

initial_experiments.success_metric: retail_product_items, product_image_items, false-positive product match rate, item-card/detail engagement once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Cleaner supply evidence and recovered product images make ranking cards more trustworthy for BSS owners, improving repeat visits and share confidence without inflating trend claims.

initial_experiments.success_metric: evidence_snapshot_review CTA clicks, ranking-card clicks, share-copy events, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners will trust and share the dashboard more when trend-backed counts, WATCHLIST counts, zero-trend categories, and missing social-commerce coverage are visible before the share CTA.

initial_experiments.success_metric: fewer avoidable TikTok Shop coverage outages, stable product images/source cards, and no increase in unsupported trend claims
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Transparent cached supply fallback preserves owner trust during upstream actor failures while keeping trend claims evidence-based.

initial_experiments.success_metric: weekly_top3 share/copy clicks with item_id context, item detail entrances by UTM content, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners and reps will share/reopen item-specific links more often than a generic ranking link when each link includes display tip, risk/caution, evidence status, and product detail context.

initial_experiments.success_metric: owner_quick_pick clicks, item detail entrances with utm_medium=quick_pick, share/copy events, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners will click and revisit more often when the dashboard surfaces store-zone action picks before the full ranking, with WATCHLIST status visible instead of hidden.

initial_experiments.success_metric: growth_click and growth_share_copy_result by component_experiment_id, section_position, item_id, UTM, and repeat item-detail entrances once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Component-level event context will show which dashboard modules actually drive BSS owner repeat visits toward 500/day, instead of treating every click as one generic hero experiment.

initial_experiments.success_metric: weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly owner brief copy events, UTM-attributed ranking returns, item-detail entrances, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners and sales reps will share/reopen a concise copy-ready 3-line owner brief more often than generic URL-only share cards because it includes floor test, add-on angle, WATCHLIST caution, and an attributed ranking link.

initial_experiments.success_metric: source_link clicks segmented by source_layer/source_kind/source_status, item detail share/copy events after evidence clicks, and UTM-attributed repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners will trust and revisit item detail pages more when evidence/source clicks can be measured separately for published trend evidence, supply validation, cached fallback, and watchlist-only links.

initial_experiments.success_metric: evidence_snapshot_review CTA clicks, item-card clicks after viewing the snapshot, owner brief/share copy events, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners will trust and share the ranking more when Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly trend windows are clearly separated from 365d captured source coverage, reducing black-box score confusion.

initial_experiments.success_metric: evidence_focus_watchlist CTA clicks, item-detail entrances with utm_medium=focus_watchlist, source-link clicks from focus items, share/copy events, and repeat visits once analytics export is available
initial_experiments.hypothesis: BSS owners and reps will trust and revisit the dashboard more when weak WATCHLIST items show a transparent next-loop evidence focus instead of a black-box score or hidden internal backlog.

reporting.daily_growth_director: Report current measured traffic if credentials exist; otherwise report tracking readiness, marketing actions, blockers, and next permission needed.
reporting.hourly_ai_operator: Keep improving product insight quality, SEO/shareability, tracking, experiments, and conversion paths while preserving source/evidence discipline.

vercel_web_analytics.measurement_note: Vercel dashboard measures visitors, page views, referrers, geography, devices, and custom events without cookies.

ga4.event_bridge: assets/growth.js sends growth_exposure, growth_click, and growth_share_copy_result through gtag when available, including session_id plus first/current UTM attribution.

internal_growth_events.purpose: A/B variant, first/current UTM persistence, session_id, share/copy/click events, and provider fan-out to Vercel Analytics and GA4.

sns_strategy.role: Drive BSS-owner repeat visits with concise, evidence-backed weekly item insights and UTM-tagged links.
sns_strategy.posting_rule_summary: After xurl is installed/authenticated, auto-post only safe evidence-backed ranking links within limits; keep replies/DMs/paid ads approval-only.
